source.note: Two tables: 'Standard PCB' and 'Advanced PCB', the second graded Normal process / Medium difficulty / High difficulty. Tier standard is the first table; tier advanced_normal is the second table's Normal process column. Medium and high difficulty cost more and are not offered as tiers.

copper_layer_counts.quote: Number of Layers - 1-14 layers For orders above 14 layers, please view the below "Advanced PCB"
copper_layer_counts.note: 1 and 2 plus even counts to 14; the inner-copper row speaks of 'Multi-layer laminated structure' for 4 to 10 layers and names no odd count.

min_track.quote: Min Trace 0.1mm/4mil Min manufacturable trace is 4mil(0.1mm)

min_gap.quote: Min Spacing Min manufacturable spacing is 4mil(0.1mm)

min_drill.quote: Drill Sizes (CNC) 0.15-6.0mm Min drill size is 0.15mm, max drill is 6.0mm. Any holes greater than 6mm or smaller than 0.2mm will be subject to extra charges.

min_annular_ring.quote: Min Width of Annular Ring 0.15mm(6mil) For pads with vias in the middle, Min width for Annular Ring is 0.15mm(6mil).

min_hole_to_hole.unpublished: The standard table gives no hole-to-hole figure; the advanced table's normal process gives one (tier advanced_normal).

min_mask_sliver.unpublished: The standard table gives no solder mask bridge; the advanced table's normal process gives one (tier advanced_normal).

min_silk_width.quote: Minimum Character Width(Legend) 0.15mm Characters of less than 0.15mm wide will be too narrow to be identifiable.

min_silk_height.quote: Minimum Character Height (Legend) - 0.8mm Characters of less than 0.8mm high will be too small to be recognizable.

copper_layer_counts.note: Normal process covers 3 to 16 layers; listed as the even counts, as elsewhere on the page.
